notes.title: Out Right Now – You can play You Suck At Football today!
notes.content: [h1]Out right now![/h1][p][/p][p]Hey everyone[b],[/b] I’m thrilled to announce that [b]Y[u]ou Suck At Football is out right now![/u][/b][/p][p][/p][h2]What to expect[/h2][p]• Singleplayer and mutliplayer physics chaos inspired by *Only Up* & *Chained Together*[/p][p]• Brutal parkour courses where one wrong kick resets your progress (there are checkpoints too)[/p][p]• Perfect for voice‑chat meltdowns and victory dances alike 🕺[/p][p][/p][h2]Play & share[/h2][p]Smash that button and tag your friends![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842740/You_Suck_At_Football/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Release Date Locked – You Suck At Football kicks off the 4th of AUGUST 2025!
notes.content: [h1]Launching on 4th AUGUST 2025![/h1][p][/p][p]Hey everyone[b],[/b] I’m thrilled to confirm that [b]You Suck At Football releases on Steam this[/b] [u][b]4th of AUGUST 2025[/b][/u].[/p][p][/p][h2]What to expect[/h2][p]• Singleplayer and mutliplayer physics chaos inspired by *Only Up* & *Chained Together*[/p][p]• Brutal parkour courses where one wrong kick resets your progress (there are checkpoints too)[/p][p]• Perfect for voice‑chat meltdowns and victory dances alike 🕺[/p][p][/p][h2]Wishlist & share[/h2][p]Smash that green button and tag your friends—every wishlist boosts visibility. [i]P.S. I’m currently integrating your awesome play‑test feedback so launch day is as smooth (and punishing) as possible. See you on the pitch![/i] ⚽️🔥[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842740/You_Suck_At_Football/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
